pageTitle: Transparency & Reports | Dr. Patience Tsavnande Foundation
pageDescription: We are committed to full transparency. View our financial reports, activity reports, and see how your donations are making a difference.
heroDescription: We are committed to full transparency and accountability. Here you can access our financial reports, activity reports, and see how your donations are making a difference.
financialReportsDescription: Complete financial transparency is important to us. View our audited financial statements and budgets.
activityReportsDescription: Detailed reports on our programs, outreaches, and events. See the impact we're making in communities across Nigeria.
meetingNoticesDescription: Public notices of Foundation meetings. Meeting minutes are kept internal for administrative purposes.
bankDetailsDescription: For direct bank transfers and donations, please use the account details below. All donations are fully accounted for and reported in our financial statements.
accountabilityDescription: The Dr. Patience Selumun Tsavnande Foundation is registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) of Nigeria. We maintain rigorous financial controls and transparency standards. Every naira donated is accounted for, and our financial reports are made publicly available.
